summary: Genesis names בְּדֹלַח among the resources of Havilah. Numbers uses its appearance to describe manna. Its precise identification is uncertain.

senses.definition: A material found in Havilah, traditionally called bdellium.

evidence.note: After mentioning the land’s gold, the verse says that בְּדֹלַח and the שֹׁהַם stone are found there.
The verse compares the appearance of manna to that of בְּדֹלַח.
